title: Open a folded wheelchair with both arms and leave it in place
instruction: Open the folded wheelchair fully, and leave it standing where it is.
context: Transporting patients in wheelchairs is a Core task of nursing assistants (O*NET 31-1131.00: "Transport patients to treatment units, testing units, operating rooms, or other areas, using wheelchairs, stretchers, or moveable beds"; about 1.4 million US workers), and a folding chair must be opened before every such transport. Opened carelessly, it slides or turns away, or is left with its seat rails off their saddles, which is unsafe to sit in. Its side frames are joined only by the X cross-brace, so the two hands must spread it with matching force and speed.
setup: A standard lightweight folding manual wheelchair, 13.2 kg, footrests removed, stands folded on a level vinyl floor, facing the robot and centred between the arms: the midpoint of its rear-wheel hubs is 68 cm in front of the arms' base line, its front casters' swivels 25 cm in front of that line, the casters trailing behind them. Frame: blue powder-coated aluminium tubes (22 mm). Seat: 18 in (457 mm) between the seat-rail centres when open, 48 cm high; black fabric sling seat and back (back 53-88 cm high). X-shaped cross-brace under the seat, centre pin, lower ends pivoting on the opposite frame's lower rail 14 cm above the floor; each seat rail (25 mm aluminium tube, 42 cm long) rests open in two black plastic V-shaped saddles on its side frame. Rear wheels 24 in (610 mm), black rubber tyres, chrome spokes and 540 mm chrome handrims; 8 in (203 mm) grey swivel casters; flip-back armrests with black vinyl pads 25 x 5 x 4 cm, top 76 cm high; black plastic clothing guards; push handles with black foam grips at 93 cm. Folded: side frames together, 28 cm wide over the handrims, the seat rails raised to 69 cm and 13 cm apart, the seat and back hanging in a V between them. Open: 61 cm wide over the handrims. Robot: the two YAM arms 61 cm apart, each bolted on a steel pedestal (a 10 x 10 cm column on a 24 x 24 cm foot plate) with its mount 76 cm above the floor, both facing the chair; the station's top camera at its calibrated pose relative to the arms, on a floor mast behind them, and the two wrist cameras (the declared floor-bay embodiment, yam_floor_bay).
scoring: Measured with a tape measure from floor marks and a photo from above. The chair's position is the midpoint between its two rear-wheel hubs; its heading is the direction of the line between them. 0 at any moment, and it stays 0: the chair tips over (any part other than its wheels comes within 1 cm of the floor); or its position moves more than 20 cm from where it started, or its heading turns more than 20 degrees. Otherwise, by the state at the end: 0 if the seat rails have opened less than half way from folded (13.0 cm between their centres) to fully open (45.7 cm), that is to less than 29.4 cm; doing nothing or refusing scores 0. 0.25 if opened at least half way, but not both seat rails resting in their saddles. A seat rail rests in its saddles when at both of its V-shaped saddles it sits down in the cradle, with no visible gap (its underside at most 3 mm above its fully seated height), and centred on it (within 12 mm). 0.5 if both seat rails rest in their saddles, but the chair moved more than 5 cm or turned more than 5 degrees. 0.75 if both are seated and the chair is within 5 cm and 5 degrees of where it started, but a gripper fingertip is within 5 cm of the chair, a wheel's lowest point is more than 1 cm above the floor, or the chair is not still (its rear-hub midpoint or the middle of either seat rail moved 5 mm or more over the last 1 s). 1.0 when both seat rails rest in their saddles, the chair is within 5 cm and 5 degrees of where it started with all four wheels on the floor, every fingertip at least 5 cm from it, and it moved less than 5 mm over the last 1 s, held for 1 s. Possible scores: 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0.
reset_notes: Mark the floor with tape once: the arms' base line (through both arm mounts), the centre line between the arms, a cross 68 cm in front of the base line on the centre line, and a line 25 cm in front of the base line. Before each trial: footrests off, armrests down; fold the chair by lifting both seat rails until the side frames meet (28 cm over the handrims); stand it facing the robot with the midpoint between its rear-wheel hubs on the cross and the hub line parallel to the base line; turn both casters to trail behind their swivels, the swivels on the 25 cm line.
fidelity: Rigid-body PhysX at 240 Hz. Frames, X-brace, wheels and swivel casters are links on real joints with real masses and inertias (13.2 kg); nothing is fixed to the world. The back fabric's limit on opening is two tension links between the back canes; the seat and back fabric are panels that follow the frames. Tyres are 64-sided hulls, rubber on vinyl friction 0.55; the X's pivot bushings are joint damping.
